Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
Operating income reached $0.7 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $41.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1789 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 12% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $12.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 78 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
